movie_title: Can you solve the trickster god riddle? - Alex Rosenthal
introduction: Loki has challenged you to a winner-take-all game to end Ragnarok. Can you beat him and win the righ
lead_intro: Join me in unraveling the strategic game proposed by Loki and discover a clever way to outsmart the trickster!

quiz.question: What is the name of the game invented by John Conway mentioned in the video?
quiz.explanation: The game mentioned in the video was invented by John Conway under the name Brussels Sprouts.

quiz.question: How many moves does the game end in when there is a single cross on the table?
quiz.explanation: When there is a single cross on the table, the game always ends in three moves.

quiz.question: What happens when a region in the game becomes enclosed?
choices: It becomes unusable and a life is lost
quiz.answer: It becomes unusable and a life is lost
quiz.explanation: When a region in the game becomes enclosed, it becomes unusable and a life is lost.

quiz.question: How many regions are produced with two crosses on the table?
quiz.explanation: With two crosses on the table, the game produces eight regions.

quiz.question: What strategy can you use to beat Loki in the game described in the video?
choices: Carve your name into the table
Connect a line to the last letter in your name
quiz.answer: Connect a line to the last letter in your name
quiz.explanation: To beat Loki in the game, you can connect a line all the way to the last letter in your name on your first move to surprise and outsmart the trickster.
